questions.question: Why can AI systems be biased?
options: They learn from data, and biased data produces biased results
They are programmed to be evil
questions.explanation: AI learns from training data — if the data contains human biases, the system reproduces and can even amplify them.

questions.question: What is digital privacy?
options: The right to control how your personal information is collected and used
Using incognito mode in the browser
questions.explanation: Digital privacy is the right to control how your personal data is collected, used and shared by companies and governments.

questions.question: What are the three levels of the digital divide?
questions.explanation: The digital divide exists in access (who has devices and internet), usage (skills) and outcomes (who benefits).

questions.question: What is a sensible first step when analysing an ethical dilemma in technology?
options: Identify the stakeholders and consider multiple perspectives
questions.explanation: Ethical analysis starts by identifying who is affected (stakeholders) and weighing different perspectives and consequences.

questions.question: How are AI and automation changing society according to the chapter?
options: They are transforming work, creativity and decision-making
They have no effect on jobs
They will disappear within a few years
questions.explanation: AI and automation transform how we work, create and make decisions — raising both opportunities and ethical questions.
